'''April 2000 Kingsport tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Kingsport, TN on 29 April 2000. [[Brian Rippetoe]] won it. It is known from Brody Hughes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d622">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-kingsport-tennessee-4-29-99-brody-s-trd622/ kingsport-tennessee-4-29-99-brody-s-tr], DeckTech (Brody "Short_Punk" Hughes, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-kingsport-tennessee-4-29-99-brody-s-trd622/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Kingsport, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Rippetoe]]
